paite: Huchi in ka en a, ngai in, cherubte lutung a vansin om ah sapphir suang hileh kilawmtak, laltutphah bangtak a kimu ahong lang hi.
heading: Pathian Thupina In Tempul Anusia

paite: Ama'n puanmalngat silhpa kiang ah, "Cherub nuai a kangtalai peite kikal ah va lut inla, cherubte kikal a meivu na khut langnih dim in va luak inla, khopi tung ah thehzak in," achi hi.
Ka mitmuh lai mahmah in akuanta hi. Huan mi ahoh lai in tempul taklam pang ah cherubte adingh ua; huang sungnungpen meipi in adimta hi.
TOUPA thupina cherubte a kipan apaitou a, inn kongpi tung ah ava dinghta a, huai inn meipi in adim a, TOUPA thupina vak in huangsung adimta hi.
Cherubte khazap gingte huangsung ponungzaw leng Pathian Bangkim hihthei in ahon houpih lai a a-om bang mai in akiza hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, puanmalngat silhpa kiang ah, "Cherubte kikal a kangtalai pei kikal a kipan mei va la in," chi a thu apiakleh, amah ava lut a, kangtalai liimte bul ah ava dinghta hi.
Huan cherubim, cherubte kikal a kipan in, cherubte kikal a mei om sawk in, ala a, puanmalngat silhpa khut ah apia a, ama'n ana la a, apawtkheta hi.
Huchi in cherubte bel akha nuai uah mihing khut bangtak ahong lang a.

Huan ka en a, ngai in, cherubte sik ah kangtalai liim li, cherub khat kiang ah, kangtalai liim khat, cherub dang kiang ah kangtalai liim dang ka mu a; kangtalai liim latdan bel beril suang zia bang ahi.
Alatdan un ali un kibatna khat anei ua, kangtalai liim khat sung a kangtalai liim dang om bang mai ahi hi.
Apai chiang un sik li in apai thei ua, apai un leng akihei ngei kei uh; himahleh amasa ngatna lam azui zel ua, apai un akihei tuan kei uh.
Huan apumpi uh apum in anungte uh, akhutte uh, akhate uleh kangtalai liimte leng akim in mit in adim a, ali ua kangtalai liimte leng.
Akangtalai liimte bil a ka zak mahmah in, "Kangtalai liimte kipei," chih ahi.
Michih in mel li chiat anei ua, mel khat cherub mel ahi a, anihna mihing mel ahi a, athumna humpinelkai mel, alina muvanlai mel ahi.
Huchi in cherubte apaitou ua; hiai bel Kebar lui gei a thil hing ka muh ahi.
Huan cherubte apai uleh kangtalai liimte leng agei uah apai tei a, cherubte'n lei a kipan paitou ding a akhate uh azak uleh kangtalai liimte'n alehngatsan ngei kei uh.
Adin uleh hiaite adingh tei ua, apaitouh uleh hiaite leng apai tei zel ua, thil hingte kha amau ah a-om hi.
TOUPA thupina inpi kongpi tung a kipan apawtkhia a, cherubte tung ah adinghta hi.

Huan cherubte'n akha uh azak ua, apawt un ka mitmuh mahmah in lei a kipan apaitou ua; kangtalai liimte akiang uah a-om zel a; huan TOUPA Inn lutna suahlam kongkhak chin ah adinghta a; Israel' Pathian thupina atung uah a-om hi.
Hiai bel Kebar lui a Israel' Pathian nuai a ka thil hing muh mah ahi; cherubte ahi uh chih ka thei hi.
Avek un maitang li leh kha li anei chiat ua, akha nuai uah mihing khut bang mai a-om hi.
Huan amel lam uh ahihleh Kebar lui a ka muh melte mah bang, alatdan uleh amau mahmah leng ahi uh; huan amazawn zel uah apai chiat uhi.
